<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈128–138 ppm) appear as: 137.56 ppm (2 carbons), 131.90 ppm (2 carbons), 130.00 ppm (4 carbons), and 128.40 ppm (4 carbons). Summing these gives 2 + 2 + 4 + 4 = 12 aromatic carbons. The remaining peak at 196.40 ppm is a carbonyl carbon, not aromatic. Therefore, the molecule contains 12 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
